title: Research Portfolio — Reproduce & Measure
summary: An advanced, interview-defense course over six reproduce-and-measure research projects. Learn the shared statistical and methodological spine once — Wilson and Newcombe intervals, pre-registration, judge-free oracles, budget guards — then reverse-learn each project (dim-stage, forge-gap, decay-pin, lossy-wall, ghost-patch, blind-cite) to defend every claim, number, and honesty caveat claim-by-claim, capped by a mock-defense capstone. Authored from the portfolio's LEARNING-ROADMAP, learn/ guides, PRACTICE, and METHODOLOGY.
prerequisites: You built or have deeply read the six repos (dim-stage, forge-gap, decay-pin, lossy-wall, ghost-patch, blind-cite).
Comfortable reading Python and basic probability (proportions and percentages).
